title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 4,001–4,050 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 麵包烘焙坊；手作麵包店

examples.en: A warm aroma of vanilla drifts from the neighborhood artisanal bakery every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早晨，巷弄街角的手作獨立烘焙坊總是飄散出溫暖迷人的香草與現烤麵包香。

examples.en: She stopped by the local bakery to pick up a fresh loaf of sourdough bread.
examples.zh: 她順道走進社區麵包店，買了一條新鮮出爐的手作酸種麵包。

examples.en: The family-owned bakery has been serving delicious pastries to the community for three decades.
examples.zh: 這家家族經營的傳統烘焙坊已經為社區鄰里供應美味烘焙甜點長達三十年。

words.definition: 法式甜點主廚；甜點大師

examples.en: The French patissier trained in Paris constructs breathtaking multi-layered entremets.
examples.zh: 曾於巴黎藍帶深造的法式甜點主廚以精湛技藝層層堆疊出宛如藝術品般的法式慕斯蛋糕。

examples.en: The head patissier demonstrated the intricate technique of sugar pulling at the masterclass.
examples.zh: 甜點主廚在大師培訓講堂上親自示範了精細繁複的手工拉糖工藝技巧。

examples.en: Every dessert created by the renowned patissier is a harmonious blend of flavor and elegance.
examples.zh: 這位享譽盛名的甜點大師所創作的每一道精緻甜品，皆是風味與優雅美學的極致融合。

words.definition: 天然酵母酸種麵包；酸麵團

examples.en: Naturally fermented sourdough bread is easier to digest due to long lactic acid fermentation.
examples.zh: 經過長時間乳酸菌發酵的天然酸種麵包（Sourdough）風味純粹微酸且更易於人體消化。

examples.en: She toasted a thick slice of sourdough and topped it with smashed avocado and sea salt.
examples.zh: 她將一片厚切天然酸種麵包烤得酥脆，再抹上濃郁的酪梨泥並撒上細微海鹽。

examples.en: Baking authentic sourdough requires immense patience throughout the long fermentation process.
examples.zh: 烘烤正宗天然酵母酸種麵包，在漫長發酵的每個環節中皆需要無比的耐心等待。

words.definition: 酸種酵母起種 (Levain / 魯邦種)；開胃菜

examples.en: Feed your active sourdough starter daily with equal parts organic flour and spring water.
examples.zh: 每天按時以等比例的有機麵粉與純淨水餵養活性極強的天然酸種酵母起種（魯邦種）。

examples.en: A healthy sourdough starter bubbles vigorously and doubles in volume within four hours.
examples.zh: 活性充沛健康的天然酸種起種會充滿密集的活力氣泡，並在四小時內膨脹至兩倍大。

examples.en: For our anniversary dinner, we ordered crispy calamari as a savory starter.
examples.zh: 在我們的結婚週年紀念晚餐上，我們點了香酥炸魷魚圈作為開胃前菜。

words.definition: 麵粉；小麥粉

examples.en: High-protein bread flour gives sourdough loaves great elasticity and structure.
examples.zh: 蛋白質含量豐富的高筋麵粉能賦予手作歐式麵包極佳的麵筋彈性與立體膨脹支撐結構。

examples.en: Sift the cake flour twice through a fine mesh strainer to ensure a tender, lump-free batter.
examples.zh: 將低筋麵粉用細濾網過篩兩次，能確保蛋糕麵糊質地細緻綿密且絕無乾粉顆粒結塊。

examples.en: Store unbleached whole wheat flour in an airtight container placed in a cool, dark pantry.
examples.zh: 將未經漂白的天然全麥麵粉密封在保鮮罐中，並收納於陰涼避光的乾燥儲藏室內。

words.definition: 麵筋；麩質蛋白

examples.en: Kneading develops strong gluten networks that trap expanding carbon dioxide bubbles.
examples.zh: 耐心揉麵能催化出強韌的麵筋網絡，牢牢鎖住發酵時不斷膨脹的微細二氧化碳氣孔。

examples.en: People diagnosed with celiac disease must strictly avoid wheat products containing gluten.
examples.zh: 經確診患有乳糜瀉疾病的患者，日常飲食中必須嚴格杜絕攝取含有麩質的小麥製品。

examples.en: Over-mixing muffin batter develops excess gluten, resulting in a dense, tough texture.
examples.zh: 攪拌馬芬蛋糕麵糊時過度劇烈攪拌會產生多餘筋度，導致烤出的蛋糕口感紮實生硬。

words.definition: 麵團發酵過程；發酵作用

examples.en: Overnight cold fermentation in the refrigerator develops deep complex grain flavor.
examples.zh: 將打好的麵團放入冰箱進行十八小時低溫冷藏發酵，能醞釀出層次極為深邃的麥香。

examples.en: Yeast converts simple sugars into carbon dioxide and alcohol during dough fermentation.
examples.zh: 在麵團發酵過程中，酵母菌會將單糖分解轉化為膨脹氣體二氧化碳與微量酒精香氣。

examples.en: Precise temperature control is vital for steady, predictable bread fermentation.
examples.zh: 精準嚴格的環境溫濕度控管，對於維持麵包穩定且可預測的發酵節奏至關重要。

words.definition: 藤籃發酵圈；藤編發酵籃

examples.en: Dust the cane banneton with rice flour before resting the shaped dough overnight.
examples.zh: 在天然藤編發酵籃（Banneton）內均勻撒上防沾黏的在來米粉，再放入整型好的麵團。

examples.en: The natural cane ribs of the banneton imprint a beautiful spiral pattern onto the loaf crust.
examples.zh: 天然藤籃內部一圈圈的立體藤條紋理，會在麵包外皮上烙印出優雅古樸的螺旋環狀紋路。

examples.en: Using a cloth liner inside the banneton prevents sticky, high-hydration dough from clinging.
examples.zh: 在發酵藤籃內鋪上一層防沾棉麻內襯布，能有效防止高含水量的濕黏麵團沾黏在藤籃上。

words.definition: 麵團水合含水量比；水合作用

examples.en: Managing high 80% dough hydration produces an open, custard-like interior crumb.
examples.zh: 熟練駕馭高達百分之八十的高含水量麵團，能烤出內部濕潤如卡士達般化口的大氣孔麵包。

examples.en: Beginners should start with a modest 65% hydration dough to practice shaping skills easily.
examples.zh: 剛接觸歐包的新手建議從百分之六十五的溫和含水量起步練習，整型操作起來更易上手。

examples.en: Proper hydration is also essential for athletes during intense marathon training in the summer.
examples.zh: 在酷暑盛夏進行高強度的馬拉松長跑訓練時，隨時補充足夠的水分與水合作用同樣至關重要。

words.definition: 水解靜置法（麵粉與水預先水合）

examples.en: The 45-minute autolyse stage allows enzymes to break down starches naturally.
examples.zh: 揉麵前進行四十五分鐘「水解法」（Autolyse）靜置，能讓小麥酵素自然軟化麵筋並提升延展性。

examples.en: Applying an autolyse rest makes the wet dough noticeably smoother and more extensible.
examples.zh: 導入水解靜置工法後，濕潤的生麵團質地會變得顯著光滑細膩且具備極佳的延展拉伸性。

examples.en: Mixing only flour and water during the initial autolyse encourages effortless gluten formation.
examples.zh: 在最初的水解靜置階段僅混勻麵粉與純水，能在完全不費力揉麵的狀態下自發形成良好麵筋。

words.definition: 麵團；生麵糊；錢財

examples.en: Gently perform stretch-and-folds every thirty minutes to strengthen wet dough.
examples.zh: 每隔半小時以雙手溫柔進行一次拉伸摺疊（Stretch and Fold），能持續強化濕黏麵團結構。

examples.en: Allow the pizza dough to rest at room temperature until it becomes supple and stretchy.
examples.zh: 將發酵好的披薩麵團置於室溫下充分鬆弛靜置，直到質地變得柔軟順滑且極易延展拉伸。

examples.en: He worked extra weekend shifts to earn some extra dough for his upcoming vacation.
examples.zh: 他在週末主動申請加班輪班，希望能為即將到來的海外度假多賺一點額外零用錢。

words.definition: 麵包金黃酥脆外皮；地殼

examples.en: High oven steam creates a blistered, crackling, mahogany-brown artisanal bread crust.
examples.zh: 烘烤初期注入飽滿蒸氣能烤出表面佈滿細緻脆泡、色澤誘人如琥珀般的極致酥脆脆皮。

examples.en: Some children prefer soft white sandwich bread with the outer brown crust removed.
examples.zh: 有些挑食的小朋友更偏好吐司內部鬆軟的白麵包，吃三明治時總要求將外圍的深色吐司邊切除。

examples.en: Geologists study the thick oceanic crust that forms the outer rocky shell of planet Earth.
examples.zh: 地質學家深入探勘研究構成地球最外層堅硬岩石圈結構的厚實大洋地殼。

words.definition: 麵包內部氣孔組織；麵包屑

examples.en: Sourdough bakers take pride in achieving a glossy, airy, open crumb structure.
examples.zh: 頂級酸種麵包師以能烘烤出內部如蜂巢般晶瑩剔透、輕盈大氣孔的組織結構為榮。

examples.en: She swept the bread crumbs off the dining table with a wooden brush after breakfast.
examples.zh: 享用完早餐後，她拿起一把精巧的木質小毛刷，輕輕拂去餐桌上掉落的麵包屑。

examples.en: A dense, uniform crumb is desirable when baking sturdy sandwich sandwich loaves.
examples.zh: 在烘烤質地紮實耐切的三明治專用方塊吐司時，細密均勻無大氣孔的組織結構更受青睞。

words.definition: 割線割包；得分

examples.en: Precise scoring with a sharp razor blade guides where the loaf expands during baking.
examples.zh: 使用極度鋒利的專業割包刀在麵包表面俐落劃出優雅弧線，能精準引導麵包在烤箱內爆裂膨脹。

examples.en: Creative bakers use intricate wheat stalk patterns when scoring their sourdough boules.
examples.zh: 充滿創意的歐包烘焙師在為圓形酸種麵包割線時，喜歡劃出繁複生動的麥穗圖騰紋路。

examples.en: The basketball star led the league in scoring throughout the entire regular season.
examples.zh: 這位當家籃球明星在整個正規賽季中技壓群雄，高居全聯盟個人總得分排行榜榜首。

words.definition: 烤箱爆發力 (Oven Spring)；春天；彈簧

examples.en: High baking temperatures trigger massive oven spring, creating a dramatic crust ear.
examples.zh: 烤箱下火高溫瞬間引爆強大的「烤箱膨脹爆發力」（Oven Spring），在割線上炸出立體高聳的麥穗兔耳。

examples.en: Trapped steam and active yeast work together to maximize dough spring during the first ten minutes.
examples.zh: 密封的烘烤水蒸氣與受熱劇烈活躍的酵母菌在進烤箱前十分鐘協同做功，將爆發力推向極致。

examples.en: Colorful cherry blossoms bloom across Taiwan's mountain trails every spring.
examples.zh: 每年初春時節，五彩繽紛的粉嫩櫻花便在全台灣各處風景秀麗的高山登山步道競相盛開。

words.definition: 法式長棍麵包 (Baguette)

examples.en: Traditional French baguettes contain only four pure ingredients: flour, water, salt, and yeast.
examples.zh: 遵循法國傳統工法的法式長棍麵包堅持僅使用小麥麵粉、純水、海鹽與酵母四種純粹原料。

examples.en: He picked up two fresh, crackling baguettes from the Paris boulangerie for dinner.
examples.zh: 他在傍晚下班途中順道在巴黎街角傳統麵包店買了兩根剛出爐、外皮脆響的法式長棍。

examples.en: Cut the crusty baguette diagonally to prepare crunchy garlic crostini appetizers.
examples.zh: 將脆皮法式長棍麵包斜切成均勻厚片，烤成金黃香脆的義式蒜香烤麵包前菜脆片。

words.definition: 法式經典可頌牛角麵包

examples.en: A golden butter croissant boasts hundreds of paper-thin, crispy honeycomb layers.
examples.zh: 一只剛出爐的金黃法式可頌切開後內部呈現出無比完美、薄如蟬翼的蜂巢狀立體層次。

examples.en: Enjoying a warm flaky croissant alongside a hot cafe au lait is an iconic French morning ritual.
examples.zh: 早晨坐在街角露天咖啡座享用一隻溫熱酥脆的可頌與一杯熱法式歐蕾咖啡，是極具法式浪漫的儀式感。

examples.en: Creating artisanal croissants requires multiple rounds of chilling, rolling, and laminating butter sheets.
examples.zh: 親手製作職人級千層可頌需要經歷多輪繁複嚴謹的冷藏、擀壓以及反覆裹油折疊工序。

words.definition: 發酵奶油（天然乳酸發酵）

examples.en: French cultured butter imparts a rich, hazelnutty aroma to laminated pastries.
examples.zh: 頂級法國諾曼第發酵奶油（Cultured Butter）帶有迷人的榛果香氣與天然乳酸芬芳。

examples.en: Cultured butter is made by fermenting fresh sweet cream with active lactic acid bacteria.
examples.zh: 發酵奶油是透過在新鮮香甜的生乳鮮奶油中接入活性乳酸菌種，經長時間低溫慢速發酵製成。

examples.en: Spreading chilled cultured butter onto warm crusty bread highlights its deep dairy complexity.
examples.zh: 將冰涼的頂級天然發酵奶油抹在剛烤出爐的脆皮歐式麵包上，能極致烘托出深邃迷人的乳香層次。

words.definition: 摺疊裹油千層工藝；層壓

examples.en: Skilled dough lamination requires maintaining butter and dough at identical cool temperatures.
examples.zh: 製作千層可頌的摺疊裹油工法（Lamination）極度考驗將奶油與麵團精準維持在相同的冰涼溫度。

examples.en: Flawed lamination causes butter to melt into the dough, ruining the crispy separation of layers.
examples.zh: 若裹油折疊溫控失誤，會導致奶油融化被麵團吸收，從而徹底破壞烘烤後層次分明的酥脆結構。

examples.en: Industrial plastic lamination protects important identity cards and paper certificates from water damage.
examples.zh: 工業塑膠護膜熱壓工藝（Lamination）能保護重要的身分證件與紙本獲獎證書免受受潮損毀。

words.definition: 法式布里歐麵包（高奶油高蛋黃）

examples.en: Rich brioche dough is packed with whole eggs and butter, creating a featherlight bun.
examples.zh: 奢華加入大量新鮮全蛋與濃郁奶油烘烤而成的法式布里歐麵包，口感極致柔軟如雲朵。

examples.en: Gourmet burger joints serve juicy grilled patties on toasted golden brioche buns.
examples.zh: 頂級精品手作漢堡名店偏好以微烤金黃的布里歐漢堡包，夾入多汁現烤的熟成牛肉漢堡排。

examples.en: Day-old brioche slices make decadent French toast when soaked in sweet cinnamon egg custard.
examples.zh: 將隔夜的布里歐麵包切片浸泡在肉桂香草蛋奶液中煎製，能做出極度銷魂誘人的經典法式吐司。

words.definition: 美式貝果麵包；水煮烘烤圈

examples.en: Boiling raw dough in malt water before baking yields a delightfully chewy bagel.
examples.zh: 在進烤箱前先將麵團放入麥芽糖滾水中汆燙數十秒，能賦予手作貝果極富嚼勁的彈牙外皮。

examples.en: She ordered a toasted sesame bagel filled with smoked salmon and herb cream cheese.
examples.zh: 她在早午餐店點了一份烘烤得外脆內軟的香濃白芝麻貝果，內餡夾滿挪威燻鮭魚與蒔蘿乳酪抹醬。

examples.en: New York-style bagels are famous worldwide for their glossy exterior crust and dense crumb.
examples.zh: 經典紐約風格美式貝果以其表面晶亮光澤的薄脆外皮與扎實飽滿、極富嚼勁的內裡聞名遐邇。

words.definition: 日式生吐司 (Shokupan)；鮮奶生吐司

examples.en: Japanese Shokupan milk bread is prized for its pillowy softness and edible crust.
examples.zh: 風靡全台的頂級日式生吐司以入口即化的綿密如絲口感與連吐司邊都軟嫩清甜而著稱。

examples.en: Artisan bakers use high-fat Hokkaido cream and the Yudane method to craft luxurious Shokupan.
examples.zh: 烘焙名師採用北海道高乳脂頂級鮮奶油結合日式湯種工法（Yudane），精心烘烤出奢華生吐司。

examples.en: Tearing into a freshly baked loaf of warm Shokupan reveals moist, cloud-like feathery strands.
examples.zh: 徒手撕開一整條熱氣騰騰的現烤生吐司，內部呈現出如雲朵般濕潤牽絲、細緻拉絲的羽毛紋理。

words.definition: 美式肉桂捲；肉桂蝸牛卷

examples.en: Freshly baked cinnamon rolls are smothered in gooey vanilla cream cheese icing.
examples.zh: 剛出爐熱氣騰騰的香濃手作美式肉桂捲上淋滿了絲滑濃郁的香草奶油乳酪白糖霜。

examples.en: The cozy cafe fills with an intoxicating aroma of brown sugar and spice from warm cinnamon rolls.
examples.zh: 溫馨文青咖啡館內瀰漫著剛出爐肉桂捲中黑糖、焦糖與濃郁香料交織的銷魂香氣。

examples.en: Savoring an indulgent frosted cinnamon roll paired with black coffee is the ultimate weekend treat.
examples.zh: 週末點上一顆淋上誘人糖霜的厚肉桂捲搭配一杯無糖黑美式，是犒賞自己一週辛勞的極致享受。

words.definition: 法式可麗露（天使之鈴）

examples.en: Baked in beeswaxed copper molds, caneles have a caramelized crunchy shell and custard interior.
examples.zh: 在塗滿天然蜂蠟的純銅模中高溫烘烤的可麗露外殼焦香酥脆，內部軟嫩如香草卡士達布丁。

examples.en: Authentic Bordeaux caneles require resting the vanilla rum batter in the fridge for forty-eight hours.
examples.zh: 正宗法國波爾多可麗露麵糊必須先加入天然香草莢與蘭姆酒，並低溫冷藏靜置熟成四十八小時。

examples.en: Achieving a deep dark mahogany color without burning the shell is the true mark of a skilled canele baker.
examples.zh: 烘烤出深沉如琥珀黑檀木般的焦脆光澤外殼且完全不烤焦發苦，是評斷烘焙師技術的最高指標。

words.definition: 法式馬卡龍（少女的酥胸）

examples.en: Delicate almond macarons feature ruffled feet and rich dark chocolate ganache fillings.
examples.zh: 精巧雅緻的法式馬卡龍擁有完美的蕾絲裙邊外圈，中間夾入濃郁絲滑的法芙娜黑巧甘納許。

examples.en: Macarons are notoriously temperamental pastries that require strict humidity and temperature control.
examples.zh: 法式馬卡龍是烘焙界出了名嬌貴難伺候的甜點，製作過程對空氣濕度與烤溫掌控有極苛刻的要求。

examples.en: The Parisian boutique arranged pastel-colored macarons in exquisite gift boxes.
examples.zh: 這間巴黎精品甜點沙龍將馬卡龍粉彩色系的小圓餅，精心陳列在緞帶燙金禮盒中。

words.definition: 瑪德蓮貝殼小蛋糕

examples.en: Fresh lemon zest madeleines rise with a signature rounded bump in shell molds.
examples.zh: 現烤出爐的清新檸檬皮屑瑪德蓮蛋糕在貝殼模具中完美鼓起標誌性的可愛圓潤小肚臍。

examples.en: Marcel Proust famously described how tasting a tea-soaked madeleine unlocked vivid childhood memories.
examples.zh: 法國大文豪普魯斯特在巨作中生動描繪了當咬下一口浸過紅茶的瑪德蓮時，童年記憶瞬間翻湧而出。

examples.en: Glazing the warm madeleines with a thin citrus sugar syrup gives them a sweet crunchy sheen.
examples.zh: 在微溫的瑪德蓮表面刷上一層薄透的檸檬柑橘糖霜，能為外層增添一層甜脆爽口的光澤。

words.definition: 費南雪金磚蛋糕；金融家

examples.en: Golden almond financiers gain their nutty depth from clarified browned hazelnut butter.
examples.zh: 烘烤至金黃酥脆的杏仁費南雪金磚蛋糕其銷魂香氣來自於將無鹽奶油高溫熬煮成的榛果焦化奶油。

examples.en: French bankers in the Paris stock district loved financiers because they did not soil their suits.
examples.zh: 巴黎證券交易所附近的銀行家熱愛隨手享用費南雪金磚蛋糕，因為食用時完全不會弄髒訂製西裝。

examples.en: A great financier has crisp caramelized rectangular edges and an unbeatably moist almond crumb.
examples.zh: 一只出色的頂級費南雪金磚蛋糕外圈金黃微焦酥脆，內裡則保持著濕潤柔軟的濃厚杏仁奶香。

words.definition: 法式甜塔；水果塔；酸澀的

examples.en: A glossy fruit tart filled with vanilla cream is topped with glazed strawberries.
examples.zh: 一只外殼酥脆的法式水果塔擠滿香草卡士達，表面鋪滿晶瑩剔透淋上鏡面果膠的新鮮大草莓。

examples.en: The patisserie's signature lemon tart has a perfectly tart curd balancing a buttery crisp crust.
examples.zh: 這家法式甜點專賣店的招牌檸檬塔以酸香明亮凝乳內餡，完美平衡了牛油香濃郁的酥脆塔殼。

examples.en: Granny Smith green apples possess a pleasantly tart flavor that holds up well during pie baking.
examples.zh: 翠綠的澳洲青蘋果帶有討喜明亮的微酸爽口風味，在進烤箱烘烤蘋果派時能保持極佳的口感與酸度。

words.definition: 泡芙；膨脹；喘氣 (Cream Puff)

examples.en: Crispy craquelin cream puffs burst with chilled fresh vanilla bean custard.
examples.zh: 表面覆蓋一層香脆菠蘿皮的脆皮泡芙一口咬下，冰涼爆漿的天然香草籽卡士達內餡四溢。

examples.en: Watch through the oven glass as the balls of choux pastry dramatically puff up with hot steam.
examples.zh: 隔著烤箱玻璃觀察，原本扁平的泡芙麵糊在強烈水蒸氣推擠下不可思議地快速鼓起膨脹。

examples.en: He let out a weary puff of air after carrying the heavy bags of bread flour up three flights of stairs.
examples.zh: 徒手將幾大袋重磅麵包麵粉一口氣扛上三樓之後，他精疲力竭地長長吁了一口大氣。

words.definition: 閃電泡芙 (Éclair)

examples.en: Chocolate eclairs are slender choux pastries filled with espresso mocha cream.
examples.zh: 經典法式閃電泡芙（Éclair）由修長酥脆的泡芙麵團製成，內部灌入香濃義式摩卡咖啡鮮奶油。

examples.en: The sweet pastry gets its French name because people devour the delicious treat in a flash.
examples.zh: 這道法式精緻甜點之所以得名「閃電」，是因為它太過美味誘人，以至於人們總是如閃電般迅速掃光。

examples.en: Each delicate eclair is dipped into glossy dark chocolate fondant icing for a mirror finish.
examples.zh: 每一根細長的閃電泡芙頂部皆會浸裹上一層晶亮的苦甜黑巧克力糖霜，散發出如鏡面般的光澤。

words.definition: 香草卡士達醬；蛋奶醬

examples.en: Whisk egg yolks, whole milk, sugar, and cornstarch gently to thicken custard.
examples.zh: 將新鮮蛋黃、全脂鮮乳、細砂糖與玉米澱粉在厚底鍋中以小火慢攪加熱至濃稠滑順卡士達醬。

examples.en: The chef piped generous amounts of velvety vanilla custard into warm Danish pastries.
examples.zh: 甜點主廚將大量質地絲滑如綢緞的天然香草卡士達醬，大方擠入微溫香脆的丹麥千層麵包中。

examples.en: Press plastic wrap directly onto the surface of hot custard to prevent a rubbery skin from forming.
examples.zh: 在剛煮好的高溫卡士達醬表面直接緊密貼上一層耐熱保鮮膜，能有效防止冷卻時表面風乾結皮。

words.definition: 天然香草豆莢；香草味的

examples.en: Scrape fragrant tiny black seeds from a plump Bourbon vanilla bean pod.
examples.zh: 拿小刀輕輕剖開並刮出肥美飽滿的波旁天然香草豆莢中數以萬計的芬芳黑色小香草籽。

examples.en: High-grade natural vanilla extract adds warmth and depth to homemade chocolate chip cookies.
examples.zh: 滴入幾滴高品質的天然純香草精，能為剛出爐的手工美式巧克力軟餅乾注入溫潤深沉的香氣。

examples.en: The software includes a straightforward vanilla version without any customized third-party extensions.
examples.zh: 該軟體套件提供了一個乾淨純粹的標準原裝版本（Vanilla Version），未包含任何第三方客製擴充套件。

words.definition: 法式蛋白霜；烤蛋白糖霜

examples.en: Whipping cold egg whites with fine caster sugar forms stiff, glossy meringue peaks.
examples.zh: 將冰蛋白加入細砂糖以電動打蛋器高速打發，直至打出拉起呈現直立硬挺有光澤的蛋白霜尖角。

examples.en: Use a kitchen blowtorch to lightly toast the swirls of meringue on top of the lemon pie.
examples.zh: 使用廚房專用噴槍在檸檬塔上方的蛋白霜雲朵線條上輕輕炙烤，烤出迷人的金黃焦香紋路。

examples.en: Baking delicate Swiss meringue kisses at low temperature dehydrates them without any browning.
examples.zh: 在低溫烤箱中慢烤精巧的瑞士蛋白霜小糖果，能將其水分慢慢烘乾且完全不變色發黃。

words.definition: 可可粉；可可豆

examples.en: Dust Dutch-processed unsweetened cocoa powder across the top of chilled tiramisu.
examples.zh: 在冰鎮冷藏定型好的經典提拉米蘇表面均勻篩上一層厚厚的頂級無糖純黑可可粉。

examples.en: A mug of steaming hot cocoa topped with fluffy marshmallows warms cold winter evenings.
examples.zh: 寒冬深夜裡，手捧一杯頂部漂浮著軟綿棉花糖的熱可可，能帶來無比療癒的溫暖暖意。

examples.en: High-quality cocoa butter gives luxury chocolate bars their smooth melting sensation on the tongue.
examples.zh: 頂級天然可可脂賦予了高端精品黑巧克力在舌尖接觸瞬間絲滑化口的極致奢華感官體驗。

words.definition: 巧克力調溫工藝；回火

examples.en: Precise chocolate tempering aligns cocoa butter crystals for a glossy shine and snap.
examples.zh: 精準嚴格的巧克力調溫降溫升溫工法能重組可可脂結晶，使成品呈現鏡面光澤與清脆斷面。

examples.en: Improper tempering results in dull gray streaks known as chocolate bloom on molded bars.
examples.zh: 若調溫工法稍有瑕疵，巧克力表面冷卻後會浮現霧面泛白斑紋（起霜），口感變得粉糙無光。

examples.en: Skilled chocolatiers use marble table scraping methods during manual chocolate tempering.
examples.zh: 經驗老道的高級巧克力工藝師在手動調溫時，擅長使用大理石檯面刮拌降溫法精準掌控結晶結晶。

words.definition: 戚風蛋糕；雪紡薄紗

examples.en: Fluffy Earl Grey chiffon cakes owe their cloud-like lightness to folded whipped whites.
examples.zh: 鬆軟濕潤的皇家伯爵紅茶戚風蛋糕其如雲朵般的輕盈蓬鬆口感來自於輕柔翻拌的打發蛋白霜。

examples.en: Invert the chiffon tube pan immediately after baking so the delicate sponge does not collapse.
examples.zh: 剛出爐的戚風煙囪烤模必須立刻倒扣在酒瓶上散熱冷卻，以防嬌嫩細膩的蛋糕體自身塌陷回縮。

examples.en: She wore an elegant chiffon evening dress that flowed gracefully with every step.
examples.zh: 她身著一襲高貴飄逸的雪紡長禮服出席晚宴，舉手投足間裙襬如波浪般輕柔搖曳。

words.definition: 動物性鮮奶油；打發鮮奶油 (35%+)

examples.en: Whip chilled 38% dairy whipping cream to soft ribbons for frosting birthday cakes.
examples.zh: 將乳脂肪含量百分之三十八的純天然動物性鮮奶油低溫打發至七分發，抹面蛋糕細膩化口。

examples.en: Always chill your metal bowl and beaters before beating fresh whipping cream.
examples.zh: 在動手打發動物性鮮奶油之前，請務必先將不鏽鋼鋼盆與打蛋棒放入冰箱充分冰鎮預冷。

examples.en: Dollop a generous spoonful of lightly sweetened whipping cream over warm apple pie.
examples.zh: 在剛出爐熱氣騰騰的肉桂蘋果派上舀上一大匙微甜的輕盈打發鮮奶油，冷熱交織銷魂無比。

words.definition: 奶油擠花裝飾；管路

examples.en: Fit a stainless star tip onto the piping bag to swirl rosettes on cupcakes.
examples.zh: 在拋棄式擠花袋前套上八齒不鏽鋼星型花嘴，俐落擠出一朵朵線條立體的杯子蛋糕玫瑰花。

examples.en: Steady hand pressure and smooth circular motions are crucial for neat piping work.
examples.zh: 保持平穩均勻的擠壓手勢力道與流暢勻稱的旋轉運筆，是擠花裝飾線條工整俐落的關鍵所在。

examples.en: The chef demonstrated piping choux pastry dough into uniform rounds on baking sheets.
examples.zh: 主廚親自示範如何將泡芙麵糊精準、均勻地擠在鋪有烤焙墊的烤盤上形成一顆顆圓潤麵團。

words.definition: 矽膠刮刀；不鏽鋼抹刀

examples.en: Use a heatproof silicone spatula to fold flour gently without deflating batter.
examples.zh: 使用耐熱食品級矽膠刮刀以切拌翻拌手法輕巧翻拌麵粉，確保打發的蛋糕麵糊完全不消泡。

examples.en: A long offset spatula helps bakers achieve razor-sharp smooth edges on frosted celebration cakes.
examples.zh: 一把長柄曲柄不鏽鋼抹刀能幫助烘焙師在塗抹生日慶典蛋糕時，刮出刀削般俐落平整的立體直角。

examples.en: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl thoroughly with a rubber spatula before continuing.
examples.zh: 在啟動攪拌機進行下一步攪拌之前，先用矽膠抹刀將盆壁邊緣飛濺的生麵糊徹底刮乾淨聚攏。

words.definition: 重乳酪蛋糕；巴斯克乳酪蛋糕

examples.en: Basque burnt cheesecake features a deeply caramelized charred top and molten center.
examples.zh: 西班牙巴斯克焦香乳酪蛋糕以其表面大膽高溫烤出焦黑琥珀焦糖色與內裡半熟流心聞名全球。

examples.en: Chill the New York cheesecake in the refrigerator overnight before slicing it with a warm knife.
examples.zh: 將經典重乳酪蛋糕放入冰箱冷藏定型整夜，切片前將主廚刀用熱水浸泡燙熱再切能切出工整切口。

examples.en: Mixing rich Philadelphia cream cheese with fresh lemon juice balances the richness of the cheesecake.
examples.zh: 將濃醇的奶油乳酪加入微量鮮榨檸檬汁攪打，能為厚重的乳酪蛋糕帶來恰如其分的清爽解膩酸香。

words.definition: 馬斯卡彭起司 (義大利頂級乳酪)

examples.en: Velvety Italian mascarpone cheese gives traditional tiramisu its rich, creamy indulgence.
examples.zh: 質地絲滑如天鵝絨般的義大利純馬斯卡彭起司賦予了傳統正宗提拉米蘇無可比擬的濃郁奶香。

examples.en: Gently fold mascarpone with whipped egg yolks and marsala wine for the classic tiramisu layer.
examples.zh: 將冰涼的馬斯卡彭乳酪輕柔拌入打發的蛋黃糊與瑪莎拉甜酒中，調製經典提拉米蘇靈魂奶霜層。

examples.en: Genuine mascarpone possesses an extremely smooth, spreadable texture with mild milky sweetness.
examples.zh: 純正的義大利馬斯卡彭起司擁有極其細膩綿密的絲滑抹醬質地，並散發出溫潤清甜的天然生乳奶香。

words.definition: 熔岩流心的；熔化的

examples.en: Pierce the chocolate molten lava cake to let warm ganache flow onto the plate.
examples.zh: 拿湯匙輕輕切開熱烤巧克力熔岩流心蛋糕，溫熱香濃的液態黑巧甘納許瞬間如岩漿般流出。

examples.en: Molten volcanic rock cools into porous basalt stone after flowing down mountain slopes.
examples.zh: 炙熱滾燙的火山熔岩在沿著陡峭山坡奔流而下冷卻凝固之後，會轉化為孔隙密布的玄武岩質。

examples.en: Careful timing is critical when baking molten puddings so that the gooey center remains delightfully liquid.
examples.zh: 烘烤熔岩流心蛋糕時對烘烤時間的掌控必須精確到秒，才能確保核心維持銷魂迷人的半熟液態流心。

words.definition: 桌上型攪拌機；電動打蛋器

examples.en: A sturdy KitchenAid stand mixer makes kneading heavy bread dough effortless.
examples.zh: 一台馬力強勁的經典多功能桌上型攪拌機（KitchenAid）能讓揉捏大份量厚重麵團變得無比輕鬆。

examples.en: Use the whisk attachment on your electric mixer to whip meringue to glossy peaks in minutes.
examples.zh: 在電動手持攪拌機上裝上球形打蛋器配件，短短數分鐘內便能將冰蛋白打發至光澤直立尖角。

examples.en: Pour the dry ingredients gradually while running the mixer on low speed to prevent flour dust storms.
examples.zh: 在啟動攪拌機低速運轉的同時慢慢倒入乾性粉類材料，能防止細微麵粉如沙塵暴般飛濺各處。

words.definition: 烘焙耐高溫烤焙紙；羊皮紙

examples.en: Line baking sheets with non-stick silicone parchment paper for easy cookie removal.
examples.zh: 在大烤盤底部鋪上一張防沾抗高溫烘焙烤焙紙，烤完後剛出爐的巧克力軟餅乾能輕鬆移起。

examples.en: Ancient European scribes meticulously transcribed sacred historical texts onto treated animal parchment.
examples.zh: 歐洲古代手抄本學者將無比神聖的歷史文獻經卷，一字一筆工整抄錄在經過精細鞣製的羊皮紙上。

examples.en: Using parchment paper prevents delicate macarons from sticking to the sheet during baking.
examples.zh: 鋪設耐高溫烘焙烤焙紙能防止嬌嫩嬌貴的法式馬卡龍底層在烘烤膨脹過程中黏底破損。

words.definition: 蛋糕模具；鑄模；發霉

examples.en: Pour the smooth batter into an 8-inch non-stick aluminum round cake mold.
examples.zh: 將過篩混合好的細膩蛋糕麵糊緩緩倒入預先塗油防沾的八吋陽極鋁合金圓形活動蛋糕模中。

examples.en: Throw away bread immediately if you notice green or white mold growing on the surface.
examples.zh: 一旦發現土司或麵包表面滋生出綠色或白色的黴菌斑點，請務必立即整包丟棄切勿食用。

examples.en: Artisanal chocolatiers polish polycarbonate candy molds with cotton balls to guarantee mirror finishes.
examples.zh: 頂級手工巧克力大師在灌模前會拿乾淨棉球反覆拋光擦拭聚碳酸酯硬模，以確保脫模後的鏡面光澤。

words.definition: 電子料理秤；刻度；磅秤

examples.en: Precision digital kitchen scales ensure every gram of salt and yeast is measured accurately.
examples.zh: 一台精準至零點一公克的數位電子料理秤能確保每一克酵母與微量海鹽皆被精準無誤量取。

examples.en: Baking is exact chemistry where relying on volumetric cups instead of a scale causes unpredictable failures.
examples.zh: 烘焙本質上是一門精準的化學工藝，單純依賴量杯容積測量而非電子磅秤秤重極易導致翻車失敗。

examples.en: Press the tare button on the scale to zero out the bowl weight before adding your next baking ingredient.
examples.zh: 在倒入下一項烘焙食材之前，先輕按電子秤上的歸零去皮按鈕（Tare），扣除攪拌盆自身重量。

words.definition: 預熱烤箱至指定溫度

examples.en: Always preheat the convection oven to 200°C for thirty minutes before baking bread.
examples.zh: 在將麵包送入烤箱之前，請務必先將風車旋風烤箱提早三十分鐘預熱至攝氏兩百度足溫。

examples.en: Placing raw dough inside an oven that failed to preheat prevents proper expansion and leavening.
examples.zh: 將發酵好的生麵團直接放進未充分預熱完全的低溫烤箱中，會導致麵包無法正常膨脹長高。

examples.en: An oven thermometer ensures that your oven has accurately reached the preheated temperature target.
examples.zh: 在烤箱內部掛上專用烤箱溫度計，能實時確認烤箱腔體是否真正精準達到了設定的預熱目標溫度。

words.definition: 糖分焦糖化反應

examples.en: High baking heat triggers caramelization, transforming simple sugars into complex sweetness.
examples.zh: 高溫烘烤會引發糖分焦糖化反應，將麵團中的單純糖類轉化為色澤金黃誘人、香氣深沉的美味。

examples.en: Slow caramelization of sweet yellow onions yields a rich, amber base for French onion soup.
examples.zh: 慢火悉心翻炒洋蔥丁引發的糖分焦糖化反應，能為濃郁經典的法式洋蔥濃湯熬出深沉琥珀湯底。

examples.en: The glossy brown shell of caneles is the result of prolonged exterior sugar caramelization.
examples.zh: 可麗露表面晶亮酥脆的迷人焦糖外殼，正是表面蔗糖在長時間高溫烘烤下深度焦糖化的結晶。

words.definition: 梅納反應 (Maillard Reaction)

examples.en: The Maillard reaction between amino acids and sugars creates the irresistible aroma of golden bread.
examples.zh: 氨基酸與還原糖在高溫烘烤下所產生的「梅納反應」，是賦予金黃出爐麵包銷魂香氣的科學秘密。

examples.en: Searing a steak in a smoking-hot cast iron skillet triggers the Maillard reaction for a flavorful crust.
examples.zh: 在燒得滾燙的鑄鐵煎鍋中高溫炙烤牛排能迅速引爆梅納反應，形成一層香氣逼人的焦香脆皮。

examples.en: Without the chemical transformation of the Maillard reaction, baked bread would remain pale, soft, and odorless.
examples.zh: 倘若沒有梅納反應這項神奇的化學轉化，剛出爐的烤麵包外皮將蒼白無力、口感軟趴且毫無香氣。

words.definition: 職人手作工藝精神；精湛匠心

examples.en: Artisan breadmaking embodies patient craftsmanship, honoring time, temperature, and ingredients.
examples.zh: 手作獨立歐式麵包烘焙體現了崇高的職人匠心精神，對時間、溫度與大自然原料致以最高敬意。

examples.en: The antique violin displays exquisite woodworking craftsmanship that has endured for centuries.
examples.zh: 這把傳世古董小提琴展現出巧奪天工的精緻木作雕琢工藝，歷經數個世紀洗禮依然光彩奪目。

examples.en: True baking craftsmanship lies in adapting recipes intuitively to varying daily room humidities.
examples.zh: 真正的頂級烘焙大師匠心，體現在能憑藉多年敏銳直覺隨當日氣候與室內濕度微調配方與工藝。
